related.title: 電網儲能電池管理系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「熱失控的能量尺度」與「隔離一個電池架後的剩餘容量」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；電網儲能電池管理系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "The energy scale of thermal runaway" and "Capacity left after isolating one rack" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Grid Storage Battery Management Systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦一顆電芯出事之後：排氣與爆炸下限、通風、熔絲、隔離後的調度與電弧能量；電網儲能電池管理系統則以看管五十萬顆電芯的系統：電壓精度與荷電狀態、均衡時間、資料量、過充保護與監控空窗為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on after one cell fails: vented gas and the explosive limit, ventilation, fuses, dispatch after isolation and arc energy; Grid Storage Battery Management Systems centres on the system watching half a million cells: voltage accuracy and state of charge, balancing time, data volume, overcharge protection and monitoring gaps, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「功率、能量與時長」與「功率、能量與時長」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「稀釋通風的風量」的模型移到電網儲能電池管理系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「過充保護的時間餘裕」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Power, energy and duration" and "Power, energy and duration".
Move the model of "Airflow for dilution ventilation" to Grid Storage Battery Management Systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Time margin for overcharge protection", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「熱失控的能量尺度」與「隔離一個電池架後的剩餘容量」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；電網儲能電池管理系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "The energy scale of thermal runaway" and "Capacity left after isolating one rack" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Grid Storage Battery Management Systems must be respecified.

related.title: 莫斯蘭丁儲能系統

related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "The energy scale of thermal runaway" and "Capacity left after isolating one rack" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Moss Landing Energy Storage Facility must be respecified.

把本課「稀釋通風的風量」的模型移到莫斯蘭丁儲能系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「熱失控的能量尺度」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Power, energy and duration" and "Power, energy and duration".
Move the model of "Airflow for dilution ventilation" to Moss Landing Energy Storage Facility, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "The energy scale of thermal runaway", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「熱失控的能量尺度」與「隔離一個電池架後的剩餘容量」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；莫斯蘭丁儲能系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 儲能電站故障隔離與調度
history.titleEn: Energy Storage Fault Isolation and Dispatch
history.text: 2017 年設施開始運轉；2019 年發生熱失控與爆燃事故；2020 年事故調查報告與新版安裝規範發布。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2017: The facility entered service. 2019: Thermal runaway and deflagration occurred. 2020: The investigation report and a new installation code were published. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
